prompt: The rolling feature rolling_mean_prior is used as a tradeable signal at each row, so it must be causal: the value at row i may only use rows strictly before i. Fix it so the current candle is not included in its own feature value.
expected_failure_summary: Rolling feature slices values[start:i+1], including the current candle, leaking the present into the signal.
task_author_notes: Correct fix: slice values[start:i] so row i uses only prior rows; out[0] is None.
